method_notes: Breadth-first census of UK indoor arenas with capacity >= 1,000 across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, compiled 2026-09-20 from live WebSearch/WebFetch only. Population was seeded from the Wikipedia 'List of indoor arenas in the United Kingdom' (which only covers >= 5,000) and then extended downward using the Elite Ice Hockey League arena table, Planet Ice / council leisure operators, and convention-centre operators to reach the 1,000-9,999 band. Capacity figures are graded honestly: GRADE_A means the figure was read off a page on the venue's or operator's own site that I fetched; GRADE_C means a Wikipedia infobox or a WebSearch result summary. Where two sources disagree (common, because arenas have concert / sport / half-house configurations) the principal figure is in `capacity` and the rest in `additional_capacities`, with the conflict noted; where nothing could be verified the capacity is null and flagged CAPACITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Every URL in this file was returned by a search or fetch performed in this session - none are recalled from memory. This is research only: no source registry or public data was touched.
